department: Engineering, Mechanics and Energy, IP Paris Doctoral School (ED IP Paris)

deadline.value: The 2026 calls closed (early call February 17, 2026; final call April 15, 2026), and no 2027 call date is published. Applications may be submitted at any time, but the doctoral-contract calls are dated.
deadline.quote: Deadline for applications on ADUM: February 17, 2026 | Deadline for applications on ADUM: April 15, 2026

also.quote: Applications may be submitted at any time during the year.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject test is mentioned on the IP Paris PhD pages checked.

supervisor.value: Before applying you need a thesis project, and the laboratory director and the doctoral school director must agree to it. Only then can the application be filed on ADUM.
supervisor.quote: one must obtain the agreements from the director of the laboratory and the director of the doctoral school | Then the application can be deposited on ADUM

also.quote: a letter of motivated support from the thesis supervisor, agreements between the laboratory and the hosting doctoral school can be secured

funding.value: Doctoral contracts are awarded through two competitive calls, and the page also lists funding from research organizations and other partners.
funding.quote: The Institut Polytechnique de Paris organizes two calls | A representative per institution whose thesis funding is concerned by the competition

entry_route.value: A master's degree is necessary for the three-year PhD at IP Paris. The five-year PhD Track is the bachelor's route.
entry_route.quote: To be admitted to a PhD at the Institut Polytechnique de Paris, it is necessary to hold a master’s degree.

notes: Specialities listed: Environmental sciences, Energy processes, Fluid and solid mechanics, Engineering materials and structures, Biomechanics, aero- and hydrodynamics, acoustics. The department page sets no fee, GRE or English rule.
